scenarios.name: Pick a sketch point in the 3D viewport

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is editing a 3D sketch with no other command or modal dialog active
`features/application/viewport-entity-selection/spatial-line-and-point.opd` is open with the 3D Sketch6 point visible and exposed
the user clicks near the point
the pick cue identifies "1. Point (3D Sketch6)"
